summary: Stage 1 Scope Calculator FE wiring verified end-to-end as Owner (HaulYeahAdmin). Page renders (no white screen), background draft autosave transitions idle→saving→saved on package/input changes, Attach-to-lead opens ScopeLeadPicker with the 2 real staging leads and attaches ('Quote for Yale Klat'), Save Range to Lead with an attached lead commits provisionally (scope-commit-ok-msg 'Range saved to the lead — provisional, not a firm quote.'), Save Range with NO lead attached opens the picker first and then commits after pick (verified after clearing localStorage — see caveat), Save Quote (firm) with survey complete + Final mode surfaces the EXPECTED graceful error banner with retry button ('Saved here, but the lead's price didn't update in Airtable…'), Retry write keeps the page alive and stays in the graceful error state (correct — staging Airtable is read-only), Saved scopes list opens (6 rows) and opening a scope shows 'Back to live pricing'. No horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: ScopeCalculator.jsx is 1212 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the room/item/access/materials scope panels, the output panels (Load / Crew&Time / Price build / Margin), and the Stage 1 commit/draft logic into sub-components/hooks (useScopeDraft, useScopeCommit).

The band shown for '2BR package only' is $650–$700, not ~$1,250–$1,400 as stated in the request. The request assumed rooms would also be scoped. Verified with Primary bedroom Avg the band lifts and load becomes 250cf/1500lb; math+tier chips render fine. Not a defect — just calling out the assumption for the next iteration.

Draft resume on page reload can silently repopulate the calculator (toast 'Recovered your unsaved draft.') even when the rep intends a fresh session. During my first test pass this made scope-save-btn disabled after the reload because r.cf ended up 0 in the resumed state. Clearing localStorage fixed it. Not blocking, but consider (a) surfacing a 'Discard draft' action next to the toast, or (b) not auto-applying resumed draft inputs when the URL has no ?lead and the caller is actively working.
seed_data_creation: Created several test scope commits attached to lead 'Yale Klat' in Mongo (range + firm-error rows now visible in the Saved scopes list). No Airtable writes succeeded (as expected in staging).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The staging Airtable is READ-ONLY — every firm commit will land in commit_state='error' with the graceful retry banner. That is CORRECT behavior, not a bug. If retesting: clear localStorage first (localStorage.clear()) before running the calculator flows, because the draft-resume feature will replay any leftover draft state and can toggle scope-save-btn into disabled if the resumed state has r.cf=0 & !pkg. Saved list already has 6 rows from prior QA — filter by created_by or timestamp when adding regression assertions.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found in Stage 1 wiring.
